name: pscat
description: PostScript for precision and imagination: render documents, charts and generative art to PNG, SVG and PDF with the pscat interpreter. Three skills plus the pscat-mcp server. Uses your installed pscat, or downloads the prebuilt one from the project's GitHub releases on first start.

interface.shortDescription: PostScript for precision and imagination: render documents and art to PNG, SVG and PDF.
interface.defaultPrompt: Draw a small generative art piece in PostScript with pscat and render it to PNG.
